name: Messages Improved
summary: Group MMS fixes, a faster inbox and iMessage
description: Improves the stock Messages app and its providers. Group MMS goes to the right thread, and conversations open faster. Optional iMessage through your own bridge server, set up under Settings > Advanced settings, with SMS fallback.
author: thooton

changes.text: Optional iMessage through your own bridge server.
Use the Sonim Messaging and Music icons and restore AppDrawer artwork [skip ci].
Mods: stock-signed builds for Messages, Launcher and Music; remove OEM signing.
Splice dex into the stock APKs for test deploys.
Verify renamed Messages hook targets in release builds.
Rename Messages Improved and preserve installed settings.
Consolidate mod builds and require authorized release signatures.
Prefetch recent messages on sustained inbox focus.
